notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet R4-SA110 (1:15): R4-SA110B 600 x 1800 illustrated (A 450 x 1350 also; the register lists A first, PNG R4-SA110A.png), R50, white class 400, no outer border. R4-SA110 is the school speed limit for other speeds (2026; 60 shown; the 30 is 80 C here, 80 D on R4-SA105).  Three parts: (1) SCHOOL panel, black border 10 inside the 5 white edge (sheet 15 / 5), outer 5..245 tall, full width (R45 / R35), fluorescent yellow-green ground; SCHOOL 100 D baseline 175 (top 75), ink 510 (45/510/45). (2) Red annulus centre (300, 600) (175 + 425), outer R297, inner R237 (the sheet's 297 / 237 from the centre line; ring 60, 3 margins); speed 240 D centred (245/235/240/235 chain -> top 480). (3) Times panel 955..1795 (845 tall, 5 edge), black border 10, R45 / R35, white: line 1 8 - 9 30/AM: 8 and 9 160 C, top 1020 (65 below the panel top), baseline 1180; dash 40 x 15 at x 214 y 1092; 30 80 C top-aligned with the numerals (top 1020) and AM 60 D on the baseline (top 1121), both right-aligned at 515; line 2 2 - 4 PM: top 1230 (210 chain), dash y 1303, PM 60 D top 1331 right at 515; SCHOOL 110 C top 1450 (170 chain) ink 475 (65/475/60); DAYS 110 C top 1615 (165 chain, 75 below) ink 295 (150/295/155). Horizontal positions of the time fragments are measured on the sheet (8 x 85-174, dash 214-254, 9 x 293-382, 30/AM right edge 515, 2 x 85, 4 x 295-392, PM x 418-515); the sheet's 40/520/40 and 45/515/40 chains match nothing drawn and are ignored. Times are the sheet's example. Approval required (OI 4.13).
